title: Here, There, and Where
label: ch:bn-here-there-and-where
canDo: I can say something is here or there, ask where it is, and deny that it is anywhere at all.

payoff.summary: The nine-cell grid closes: three heads — near, far, asking — across three frames — thing, person, place. The last cell is কোথায়, the question an A1 candidate is asked in the first minute of a speaking test, and answering it needs the letter থ.
payoff.note: এখানে and কোথায় both returned zero matches across 139 lessons, and কোথায় additionally could not be printed: থ was shown in the corpus and taught nowhere.
